slot_calendar_rule: AMD: Jan/Feb Q4 previous calendar year, Apr/May Q1, Jul/Aug Q2, Oct/Nov Q3; NVDA: Feb Q4, May Q1, Aug Q2, Nov Q3. Within issuer+filing year+slot preserve the earliest numeric original outlook; qualitative AMD2011 Jan remains unknown rather than filled; NVDA May2014 no-outlook press release remains separate earlier event and numeric outlook first usable at May8 filing.
acceptance_timing: Use original filing-header date only as prospective next Qlib signal lower bound; never backdate later outlook to earlier earnings release or treat API Z as true UTC.
required_checks: From 133 source 8-K Item2.02 candidates and 11 nonmatch adjudications, 125 numeric original outlook filings after 3 preliminary exclusions and 1 qualitative AMD filing; 63 issuer-year-quarter slots per issuer through 2026-Aug, no duplicated selected slot, all selected raw hashes/NAS receipt known.
stop: Any selected slot ambiguity or unsupported missingness stops before numeric harmonization; no outcome read, no market-based selection.
